query: Walking 5 km an hour, how long would it take to walk the length of the Great Wall of China?
answer:
It depends on which "Great Wall" you count. China's official figure, from a survey announced in 2012, is 21,196 km. That total includes every wall, trench and natural barrier built by many dynasties over more than 2,000 years [1][2]. At 5 km/h, that works out to about 4,240 hours of walking. Nonstop, that's about 177 days, or nearly 6 months. At a more realistic 8 hours a day, it's about 530 days, or roughly a year and a half.

If you only mean the Ming-dynasty wall (about 8,852 km), which includes most of the best-preserved sections [1], it would take about 1,770 hours. That's about 74 days nonstop or about 221 days at 8 hours a day.

In practice it would take longer, because the wall runs over steep, broken terrain and has parallel branches and gaps, so you couldn't keep a steady 5 km/h or walk it as one line.

sources.title: How Long Is the Great Wall of China? Half the Equator! - China Highlights
